title: Engram Project Anchor V3
description: The complete V3 `.engram-project` anchor document. It identifies a logical project anchor but never contains a server canonical project key, path, remote, credential, token, principal, or private payload.

project_id.description: Immutable random anchor UUID. When accepted, the server maps it to Project.anchor_project_id and binds that field to one canonical Project.project_key; it is not itself the tenant key.

name.description: Mutable display metadata. It is not an identifier and never participates in project resolution or merge authorization.

scope.description: The explicitly declared root kind for this anchor.
